candidate.name: Rameshwar Prasad
candidate.oneLiner: Two-term Gram Panchayat Mukhiya & Taal Kisan Morcha voice. Grassroots delivery focus: ward naali (पक्की नाली), handpump repairs (चापाकल), school boundary wall, and flood boat staging across Ghoswari–Maranchi.

pillars.title: हर टोला शुद्ध पानी (Clean Drinking Water)
pillars.detail: Solar handpumps, soak-pits, ward-wise pipeline fix

pillars.title: ताल नाली व निकासी (Taal Drainage & Desilt)
pillars.detail: Rabi season dewatering cuts, Ghoswari canal clearing

pillars.title: स्कूल चारदीवारी व सुरक्षा (School Safety & Walls)
pillars.detail: Boundary walls, girls' toilets, flood shelter rooms

pillars.title: बूथ संपर्क मार्ग (Booth & Tola Link Roads)
pillars.detail: Kachha-pakka road culverts connecting inner tolas to NH-31

localBase.ecology: Lower Taal basin & rural diara belt — silt, flooding & rabi lentil farming

worksPortfolio.title: Ward 04 पक्की नाली व सोक-पिट (Paved drain)
worksPortfolio.summary: Concrete drain & soak-pit covering 450m in Ghoswari to eliminate monsoon waterlogging.

worksPortfolio.title: सार्वजनिक चापाकल मरम्मत अभियान (Handpump repair)
worksPortfolio.summary: Replaced cylinders and pipes for 28 deep handpumps across drought-prone tolas.

worksPortfolio.title: प्राथमिक विद्यालय चारदीवारी (School boundary wall)
worksPortfolio.summary: Constructed brick boundary wall and iron safety gate for Maranchi Govt Middle School.

worksPortfolio.title: बूथ 92–95 शेड व पेयजल व्यवस्था (Booth shed & water)
worksPortfolio.summary: Covered passenger & voter shed with drinking water tank near polling station hub.

worksPortfolio.title: बाढ़ राहत नाव व राहत सामग्री मंच (Flood rescue staging)
worksPortfolio.summary: Pre-monsoon country boat roster and raised dry staging platform during Ganga high-water.

worksPortfolio.title: ओटा–घोसवारी संपर्क पुलिया (Culvert link)
worksPortfolio.summary: Box culvert on farm access track to keep rabi tractors moving during post-flood weeks.
